# Pinned native source inputs — not qualification

Unmodified primary material is content-addressed under raw/. provenance.json retains original paths, immutable source revisions, public URLs, raw SHA256 and primary-tree git blob identities. The full-module notice superset preserves copyrights, conditional usage and versions; it does not assert every optional library was compiled. Upstream literal tabs are accepted only in the parsed attribution view, never normalized in retained bytes.

Release metadata is separate version evidence, not a license. These inputs are not native.json or an approval flag. Semantic correspondence still requires reviewed component policy and fresh runtime facts. Full immutable source archives, including upstream build/configuration and vendored code, are linked per module. Give recipients clear adjacent source directions and maintain equivalent access under applicable terms. Artifact expiry is not a license exemption.

The selected profile requires official external VC++ x64 and conveys no Microsoft runtime DLLs. Optional Qt Mesa is omitted for the application's default raster/GDI route; Chromium's independent graphics resources remain.
